description: This file implements the TypeCodec class for serializing and deserializing type information in Orleans serialization framework. It handles encoding and decoding of type metadata with versioning support, caching mechanisms, and type parsing.

classes.name: TypeCodec
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for serializing and deserializing type information, including versions, using internal caching and type conversion.

classes.name: TypeKey
classes.description: An internal struct representing a type's hash code and name for caching and equality checks.

methods.name: WriteLengthPrefixed
methods.description: Writes a type's name with a length prefix to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteEncodedType
methods.description: Writes a type's encoded representation, including version, hash code, and name length.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read a type from the buffer, using cache for efficiency.

methods.name: ReadLengthPrefixed
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed type name and parses it into a Type object.

methods.name: TryReadForAnalysis
methods.description: Tries to read type information for diagnostics without throwing exceptions, providing the type and its name as string.
